cta.heading: Let us build it with you
cta.body: Tell us what you are trying to solve. You get an honest assessment and a clear quote — free, no pressure.

whyChoose.title: Local team, direct access.
whyChoose.body: We are based in Surat, in your timezone and your language. You talk to the people building your project, not a support queue.

whyChoose.title: Deep tech, done right.
whyChoose.body: A modern, maintainable stack built for performance and long-term growth, not quick throwaway work.

whyChoose.title: India-first by default.
whyChoose.body: GST, UPI, and WhatsApp integration are baked into how we build, not bolted on later.

whyChoose.title: We ship.
whyChoose.body: Clear milestones, transparent pricing, and work delivered in phases so you see progress fast.

whyChoose.title: We build our own products.
whyChoose.body: We run the same standards on our own SaaS that we bring to your project.

process.title: Discovery.
process.body: We map your goals, audience, and budget, then agree on a clear scope.

process.title: Plan & design.
process.body: Structure, design, and approach built for results from day one.

process.title: Build & execute.
process.body: Delivered in focused sprints with regular check-ins, so you are never in the dark.

process.title: Launch & measure.
process.body: A smooth go-live, then real numbers so we know it is working.

process.title: Support & scale.
process.body: Ongoing improvements and growth as your business expands.

industries.intro: Surat runs on textiles, diamonds, jewellery, and fast-growing trading and retail businesses — each with its own needs. We build for:
items: Jewellery & diamond retailers and CAD studios

closing.home: Big ideas get stuck in slide decks. We get them shipped.
closing.workIndex: Every project here started as a maybe. Yours could be next.
closing.booked: Your slot is locked in. Now we do the homework.
